title: 第3527章 我要好好逼问他们第3526章 竟然还是双胞胎
slug: 多子多福这个世界美女太多
lines: 蕴养了这么长时间的时空法则，第一次使用，效果让李长生很满意。
之前李长生感受到的是两尊神帝巅峰的修士，但是真正见到之后才发现，这两人竟然只有神帝后期的修为。
李长生看着两人，心中暗想：
“神帝后期的修为，却能够释放出神帝巅峰的波动。”
“这两个小姑娘底子不错啊......”
其他人也纷纷从界舟飞了下来：
“这就是那两只老鼠？”
岳灵溪心中有些紧张：
“主人，您刚才说的，就是让她们两个分担我们的工作？”
苏清鸢脸上醋意满满：
“这两个人可是双胞胎......”
乔若雪眉头微微皱起，似乎想到了什么：
“我见过这两个人......”
“她们是洛冥渊的手下，洛幽和洛影。”
此刻的洛幽和洛影被时空法则禁锢，无法移动更无法说话。
李长生看向乔若雪：
“洛幽，洛影？”
乔若雪点头：
“正是，奴家是炼魂宗的少宗主，看过门中珍藏的很多典籍。”
“其中一本记载洛家的典籍之中，就有这两人的画像......”
“她们乃是双胞胎姐妹，是当年洛家老祖洛殇带到洛家的。”
李长生有些诧异：
“洛家还有老祖？”
洛青衣站了出来：
“不过据我所知，洛家老祖早就陨落数千年。”
“这两个小姑娘也确实是洛家的手下，当年她们还曾经对我出手，被我打伤之后逃走了。”
“没想到现在竟然还敢打我女儿的主意。”
说话间，洛青衣身上神皇修为蓦然施展，就要对两人出手。
洛幽和洛影瞳孔微微一颤，心中掀起了滔天巨浪：
“神皇？”
“洛青衣竟然晋升到了神皇？”
“该死的，族长不是说她已经身受重伤，修为最高半步神皇吗？”
“还有这李长生，怎么会这么强？”
“这种诡异的法则之力，跟我们见过的所有法则都不像......”
“他也隐藏了实力。”
洛青衣伸手成爪，就要捏碎两人的脖颈。
洛幽和洛影绝望地闭上了眼睛，等待死亡的降临。
但就在此时，李长生的声音响了起来：
“岳母大人，且慢......”
黯灭见此，捂嘴偷笑，心中暗道：
“姑爷老毛病又犯了。”
content_en:
The law of time and space that had been cultivated for such a long time was used for the first time, and Li Changsheng was very satisfied with the effect.
Before, Li Changsheng felt that they were two cultivators at the peak of the God Emperor, but after actually seeing them, he discovered that these two people only had the cultivation level of the late God Emperor.
Li Changsheng looked at the two people and thought to himself:
"The cultivation of the God Emperor in the later stage can release the fluctuations of the God Emperor's peak."
"These two little girls have good foundation..."
Others also flew down from the boundary boat:
"Are these two mice?"
Yue Lingxi felt a little nervous:
"Master, what you just said was to let the two of them share our work?"
Su Qingyuan's face was full of jealousy:
"That must be the case..."
"These two are twins..."
Qiao Ruoxue frowned slightly, as if she thought of something:
"I've seen these two people..."
"They are Luo Mingyuan's subordinates, Luo You and Luo Ying."
At this moment, Luo You and Luo Ying were imprisoned by the laws of time and space, unable to move or speak.
Li Changsheng looked at Qiao Ruoxue:
"Luo You, Luo Ying?"
Qiao Ruoxue nodded:
"Exactly, the Nu family is the young master of the Soul Refining Sect and has read many classics collected in the sect."
"One of the classics that records the Luo family contains portraits of these two people..."
"They are twin sisters who were brought to the Luo family by Luo Shang, the ancestor of the Luo family."
Li Changsheng was a little surprised:
"There are still ancestors in the Luo family?"
Luo Qingyi stood up:
"Not bad..."
"But as far as I know, the ancestor of the Luo family has been dead for thousands of years."
"These two little girls are indeed subordinates of the Luo family. They attacked me back then and escaped after being injured by me."
"I didn't expect that you would dare to take advantage of my daughter now."
While speaking, Luo Qingyi's Divine Emperor cultivation suddenly came into play, and he was about to take action against the two of them.
Luo You and Luo Ying's pupils trembled slightly, and huge waves arose in their hearts:
"God Emperor?"
"Luo Qingyi was promoted to God Emperor?"
"Damn it, didn't the clan leader say that she has been seriously injured and her cultivation level is at least half a step to the God Emperor?"
"And this Li Changsheng, how can he be so strong?"
"This strange power of law is unlike any law we have ever seen..."
"He also hid his strength."
Luo Qingyi stretched out his hands into claws and was about to crush their necks.
Luo You and Luo Ying closed their eyes in despair, waiting for death to come.
But at this moment, Li Changsheng’s voice rang:
"Mother-in-law, wait a minute..."
Seeing this, Yan Mie covered his mouth and snickered, thinking secretly:
"My uncle has made his old habit again."
